plugins.name: backlog-tools
plugins.description: Backlog-native skills for the Backlog product itself, shared by every host — install it in Claude Desktop and in herdr alike: writing a Backlog import plan from an agreed specification, running one item of such a plan when it is pasted back out of the app, moving an entry to Done once its pull request merges, checking a finished plan once at the end — what landed against the plan, that it all builds, and fixing the gaps the person accepts — turning another to-do tool's export into an inbox import manifest, answering the private reading notes the app holds on a repository's Devbook chapters, reporting what the week's delivery runs cost in tokens across every repository, running the GTD weekly review over the Inbox, the Brain and the backlog without changing anything, tending the Second Brain notes folder by the rules it carries, filing a Backlog task for each remark routed to one and triaging the app's inbox into it, levelling a devbook and its code in the sync direction Backlog keeps for each unit, as draft pull requests, keeping the person's goals current — attaching new work to a goal, proposing impediments, and reporting each goal's standing and next step — and bringing a long-running session level with its base branch, re-checking the artifacts, import plans, branch and pull requests it produced against what landed; plus a Claude Code hook that forwards a session's tool and token telemetry to the app. The Claude Desktop-only parts live in backlog-desktop, the herdr-only ones in backlog-herdr.

plugins.name: backlog-desktop
plugins.description: The Claude Desktop half of the Backlog tooling, installed beside backlog-tools in Claude Desktop only: execute-plan, which runs a whole Backlog plan through nested Claude Desktop sessions with one worktree and pull request per entry; dispatch-sessions, the Manager session that turns each session request the app queues into a Claude Desktop session and hands each accepted answer back to the session waiting on it; a hook that reports each Claude Desktop scheduled run's start and finish to the app's Schedules page; and a function-hook module that shows a running plan's progress, with each entry's delivery-flow stages, in a band above the prompt and a pane. Depends on backlog-tools.

plugins.name: backlog-herdr
plugins.description: The herdr half of the Backlog tooling, installed beside backlog-tools in herdr only. Empty for now: it holds no skill or hook yet, and is the home the herdr session host's own parts land in.
